chinaman_adventurer_body: Keep the exact design, colours and placement of every feature. A lean, muscular East Asian man with warm light-tan skin; dark brown hair painted on the scalp; an ornate black-and-gold band with spiral scroll engraving over the right eye and brow; grey-green eyes and a thin tear-like scar under the eye. Small yellow talisman paper strips with red brush marks painted on the chest, forearms and shins, kept as abstract red brush strokes. Dark olive-green loincloth shorts with a gold cloud-scroll pattern and gold trim. Target: realistic skin with pores, subtle subsurface warmth, natural muscle definition and veins, detailed hands and feet with nails and creases, fine woven fabric with gold thread embroidery on the shorts. No text, no logos, no added clothing or armour.
chinaman_adventurer_hair: Keep the exact shape, colour and strand direction. Short-to-medium straight hair in chestnut to dark reddish brown, layered, with a fringe falling over the forehead and longer layered strands down the back of the neck; strands flow downward and slightly sideways, darker near the roots with warm auburn highlights toward the tips. Target: realistic hair with fine individual strands, natural sheen and anisotropic highlights, soft shadow at the roots, clean tapered strand tips. Keep a single natural hair colour. No text, no logos, no hats, ribbons or accessories.
ch_m_heavy_01_ba: Keep the exact design, colours and pattern placement. A Chinese heavy lamellar cuirass over a padded tunic. Torso: a grid of rust-brown hardened leather and copper plates in horizontal rows, each fixed with small round iron rivets, dark gaps between plates. Across the upper chest and upper back: a band of dark hammered iron with large dome rivets. Shoulder straps of deep red lacquered leather ending in small gold ornamental clasp plaques; a pale cream stand-up collar. Long sleeves of cream-ivory quilted linen with soft folds, finished with dark teal-green cloth cuffs. Target: aged copper and leather plates with patina, scratches and edge wear, hammered iron with dents, woven linen with visible weave and stitching, glossy red lacquer. No text, no logos.
ch_m_heavy_01_la: Keep the exact design, colours and pattern placement. Armoured trousers of a Chinese heavy soldier. ch_m_heavy_01_fa: Keep the exact design, colours and pattern placement. Knee-high heavy soldier boots. ch_sword_01: Keep the exact design, colours and proportions. A plain Chinese straight double-edged sword (jian), the starter copper sword.
